nodes.description: mapping(address=>uint256) public balances; stores token balances and is mutated by transfer/transferFrom with unchecked arithmetic.
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) public allowance; spender approvals read by transferFrom and written by approve.
IRC20 wwwa; externally controlled contract reference used as an access gate via wwwa.raz().
uint256 public totalSupply = 10*10**12*10**18; minted to deployer in constructor.
string public name = 'NanoInari'; token metadata.
string public symbol = hex'4E616E6F496E617269f09fa68a'; token metadata.
uint public decimals = 18; token metadata.
constructor(IRC20 _info) sets wwwa and assigns the whole totalSupply to msg.sender.
balanceOf(address owner) public view; returns balances[owner] and is used as an internal guard before arithmetic.
transfer(address to, uint256 value) public; gates on wwwa.raz(msg.sender), then debits/credits balances with unchecked arithmetic.
raz(address account) external view override; always returns 1, making the gate in transfer/transferFrom depend on the external wwwa contract.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value) public; gates on wwwa.raz(from) and allowance, then mutates balances with unchecked arithmetic.
approve(address spender, uint256 value) public; writes allowance[msg.sender][spender].
msg.sender; caller identity used for balance ownership, allowance keying and as the argument to the external wwwa.raz gate.
balances[to] += value in transfer; unchecked uint256 addition under pragma 0.7.2 (overflow possible).
balances[msg.sender] -= value in transfer; unchecked subtraction after a balanceOf comparison (rounding/underflow risk on state drift).
balances[to] += value in transferFrom; unchecked uint256 addition.
balances[from] -= value in transferFrom; unchecked uint256 subtraction.
External call wwwa.raz(...) used as an access-control gate before state mutation; wwwa is an arbitrary contract so the call can execute attacker code (callback/reentrancy surface).
address to parameter of transfer; destination of the credited balance.
uint256 value parameter of transfer; amount applied to both balance mutations.
address from parameter of transferFrom; debited account and argument to the external raz gate.
address to parameter of transferFrom; credited account.
uint256 value parameter of transferFrom; amount checked against allowance and balances.
address spender parameter of approve; allowance mapping key.
uint256 value parameter of approve; allowance amount stored.
address owner parameter of balanceOf; lookup key into balances.
address account parameter of raz; unused by the returning constant.
IRC20 _info parameter of the constructor; stored into the wwwa state variable.
